title: Engine Logging via UZ_LOG with Category System
description: All engine logging must use UZ_LOG(Category, Level, ...) macro — never spdlog directly. Each subsystem declares its own log category via UZ_DECLARE_LOG_CATEGORY / UZ_DEFINE_LOG_CATEGORY. This enables per-category filtering, consistent formatting, and engine-level log routing. Similarly: UZ_CHECK/UZ_ENSURE for assertions (not raw assert()), UZ_PROFILE_SCOPE for profiling (not raw Tracy macros).
whenToUse: Every time you need to log in engine code. When creating a new subsystem (add a new log category). When adding assertions or profiling scopes.
whenNotToUse: In thirdparty code that has its own logging. In unit tests where direct output is acceptable.
